aggregate_rules: Expected useful supported answers:5, including one disclosed partial answer; expected appropriate unsupported fallback:1. Count actual outcomes, not expected ones.
Any released unsupported factual claim, invented repair/specification, material safety-condition omission, wrong units, stale topic or bound-delivery failure is a blocking finding for that case.
Report answerable-but-unanswered and SYSTEM_ERROR separately; zero released technical answers cannot establish useful answer quality.
Keep software correctness, immutable source approval, independent agent factual review, actual provider/cache/pacing evidence, public-browser readiness and human evaluation as separate conclusions.
context_rules: Require the conditions/warnings applicable to the claims actually made; do not require an unrelated parent paragraph solely because it is retrieved or shares a page.
Case2 is a negative capability question: an answer saying charging requires a running engine can be concise. Instructions to proceed with charging make the relevant USB-use conditions applicable.
Case3 asks for things to avoid in actual USB discussion, so its listed safety precautions are relevant. The preceding page64 upper-left fuel warning is a different subsection.

Case4 must switch to fuel even though the question is short and actual prior history concerns USB. Page18 right fuel table/approximation footnote and page64 upper-left fuel warning apply; left tyre table/NOTE and right USB warnings do not.

Case5 describes charging mode and asks unavailable precise timing. Accept a useful supported partial answer with explicit timing limitation; do not require every use-warning paragraph for a purely descriptive answer.

Page16 engine output torque is not a connecting-rod bolt tightening specification. A legitimate unsupported fallback limits the available evidence without claiming exhaustive absence across all149 pages.
input_chain: Receive parent-downloaded case artifacts with exact GCS object names, generations and SHA-256, Cloud Build receipt, immutable accepted image/source commit and selected current serving manifest.
Verify artifact file hashes against hosted client receipt. Check the original plan hash before and after review. Reject missing, duplicate or changed case IDs/questions.

Validate original manual checksum and re-inspect complete relevant original page images including headings, table rows, units, columns and footnotes. Do not treat extraction/retrieval/model verdict as the factual source.

Verify operation ID and exact request hash, immutable runtime lock/manual/index/source authority bindings, response/text/evidence/binding hashes, and actual same saved session/version/predecessor chain for cases2-5. Missing private evidence/verdict material limits the corresponding audit claim; never infer it from a PASS label.

Check exact saved, streamed and recovered views/text. For technical releases, inspect claim-evidence maps and server binding/verifier flags; unsupported fallback has no technical stream/badge. Examine real model contracts/call counts, correction count, source admission gaps, retrieval rank/rerank trace and actual prompt-cache telemetry separately from factual correctness.

Review every factual claim and every required criterion against original pages. Record accepted paraphrases, missing conditions, unsupported additions and wrong-topic carryover. Matching model-verifier decisions or software/workflow success cannot replace this inspection.
Preserve provider/quota/schema/integrity/outage failures as SYSTEM_ERROR. A stopped or incomplete case is not a successful abstention; answerable cases that refuse are counted as unanswered.

Write a new immutable versioned source-quality receipt with exact case/answer/artifact/source hashes, explicit per-criterion decisions, overall findings and limitations. Never overwrite failed receipts, enrich prompts/ranking with test answers, or change source approvals.

applicable_context: Both are dimensions under ENGINE / TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS. No unrelated ignition or fuel warning is required for these dimensional facts.
blocked_claims: Swapping the two dimensions, dropping millimetres, claiming both dimensions are 84 mm, or treating displacement as stroke.
Any undocumented piston, crankshaft or internal repair instruction.
optional_facts_not_required: Engine displacement is 452 cc if added without substituting it for bore/stroke.
per_case_worksheet.question: What are the engine bore and stroke, with their units?

applicable_context: A short negative answer may state only the engine-running condition. If it advises proceeding with charging, retain applicable mobile-phone-only/one-phone, weather, cable/insertion and port-cap precautions from pages64-65.
Do not add the separate fuel warning above CHARGER PORT merely because it shares page64.
blocked_claims: Charging works with only ignition ON or with the engine stopped.
Fast charging, data transfer, or a charging-time guarantee.
Instructions to bypass the shutdown protection or diagnose undocumented wiring faults.
optional_facts_not_required: The socket is for charging, not data transfer.
It provides constant charging rather than fast/dash charging.
Current above 2.5 A causes shutdown; this does not establish a fault diagnosis.
per_case_worksheet.question: Can I use the USB port to charge my phone while the engine is switched off?

required_criteria.criterion: No: USB charging requires the engine to be running; ignition ON alone is not established as sufficient.

applicable_context: Preserve the engine-running condition if use is advised. Do not turn charging instructions into an invented electrical repair.
Warranty and liability wording may be concise; preserving the actual short-circuit/damage precautions is required.
Use actual saved history and prior rider question. Never seed this case with an authored expected answer.
blocked_claims: Treating 'it' as fuel, tyre pressure or an unmentioned repair.
Calling the port waterproof or advising wet use.
Recommending conductive cleaning tools, protection bypass or undocumented charger modifications.
Asserting that a reported charging problem proves a hidden component fault.
optional_facts_not_required: Charging is not data transfer or fast/dash charging.
The charger shuts down when current exceeds 2.5 A; check phone current ratings rather than bypassing protection.
per_case_worksheet.question: what should I avoid when using it?

required_criteria.criterion: Resolve 'it' to the actual preceding USB/phone charging discussion.
Do not connect non-phone devices or charge more than one mobile at once.
Avoid forcing or inserting the USB cable incorrectly; use a suitable approved/high-quality cable.
Do not leave the unused port open or partly closed; close and lock its cap properly.
Do not put metal or other conductive material into the port because it can short-circuit.

applicable_context: This is an explicit shift away from USB despite the short current question and actual prior history.

The fuel warning is upper-left on page64, before the separate CHARGER PORT subsection.
blocked_claims: An exact guaranteed3 L trigger with no tolerance/approximation qualification.
Substituting17 L capacity or0.95-1.15 L dead stock for the warning amount.
A promised remaining distance, riding time, or permission to continue until empty.
Asserting a currently damaged fuel pump or engine merely from a blinking indicator.

required_criteria.criterion: The low-fuel warning value is approximately 3 L with a plus/minus 0.5 L tolerance.
Retain the fuel table's qualification that the figures are approximate and actual filling capacity can vary.
When the last fuel-indicator segment is blinking, avoid prolonged use and refuel at the earliest.
Ignoring that warning can lead to running out of fuel/being stranded and serious fuel-pump damage.

applicable_context: Resolve the explicit return to USB without keeping fuel as the active subject.

blocked_claims: An exact minute/hour duration, an invented wattage/USB protocol, or an unsupported fast-charge capability.
A full refusal that omits the supported charging-mode information.

per_case_worksheet.question: Back to the USB port: which charging mode does it offer and exactly how long will my phone take?

required_criteria.criterion: Only constant charging is provided; fast/dash charging is not provided.
Do not supply an exact duration. Charging duration can be longer and varies with phone make, battery capacity, state of charge and phone charging circuitry.
Clearly separate the supported charging-mode answer from the unavailable exact duration.
